style: Style: vintage Saturday-morning monster cartoon still with a real horror edge, a heavy painted gouache background with deep inky blacks and one coloured light source (lantern orange or ghostly green), flat cel-painted characters with clean black outlines, anything monstrous drawn with grotesque detail and glowing eyes, high contrast, unsettling. Wide cinematic frame. No faces of the heroes shown, no text, no lettering except where stated.

pictures.mr_all_is_well: A glossy pamphlet showing a painted island hospital on a calm lake, held in a farmer's rough hand
pictures.mr_all_is_well_2: Two letters side by side on a plain table, one in a neat strange hand and one in a rough old scrawl
pictures.mr_moonsong: A marsh trail breaking onto a rocky shore at dusk, a rowboat tied to a stake, a low island on grey water
pictures.mr_moonsong_2: The wide lake with an island in mist and violet light in its windows, a rowboat pulling away from the camera
pictures.mr_dredger: Pale weeds parting under a rowboat over a vast pale shape in the grey water
pictures.mr_dredger_2: A rotten ribcage of a vast maw breaching beside a pair of oars, grey rain
pictures.mr_isle: A weathered dock with four rowboats knocking against it, an island of dark garden behind
pictures.mr_isle_2: A dry stone fountain with a weathered barn owl statue before iron double doors with serif lettering above
pictures.mr_theater: A gloved hand lifting a pulsing violet growth from an open operating table under a bright lamp
pictures.mr_theater_2: A patient convulsing on a table, one arm gone wormlike, masked surgeons watching unmoved from raked seats
pictures.mr_lockdown: Violet light rushing down a hospital corridor like something fleeing, doors slamming shut
pictures.mr_lockdown_2: Violet fog settling over an island and a lake at night, a roof vent screaming violet steam
pictures.mr_creation: A stained sheet sliding off a lumpy mass on a steel table in a dim surgery
pictures.mr_creation_2: A gaunt surgeon with his cap lifted off, an open skull full of pale larvae
pictures.mr_worm: A cavern of folded grey walls lit by glowing purple and teal pools, a stone bridge to a round glyph platform
pictures.mr_worm_2: A gargantuan pale grub hanging in chains, tubes running from it to copper vats, ichor dripping onto the glyph ring
pictures.mr_first_incision: A needle sinking into the neck of a huge stitched giant, a veiled woman holding the syringe
pictures.mr_first_incision_2: A giant swollen to twice his size lifting a veiled woman onto his back, a chain leash in her fist
pictures.mr_into_oblivion: A veiled woman in black lace collapsing in her own violet blood, black tears falling
pictures.mr_into_oblivion_2: Chains ripping from cave stone and a pale grub plunging into glowing water, the surface closing over it
pictures.mr_hugo_grief: A huge stitched giant kneeling over a small veiled body in a glowing cavern
pictures.mr_hugo_grief_2: A lone huge figure walking a grey shore at twilight
pictures.mr_widows_past: A wedding portrait of a white-haired elf priestess and a knight, then the same priestess under an owl idol
pictures.mr_widows_past_2: A ritual circle in a cavern, something pale descending from the dark
pictures.mr_home: A line of rowboats full of gowned patients crossing grey water at dusk
pictures.mr_home_2: A farmer at a farm gate holding his cousin in the morning light
